stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: SID 9000001 triggered — detection logic matches TCP SYN from WEB zone (10.1.100.0/24) to DB-OLTP zone (10.1.200.0/24) on PostgreSQL port 5432, which is the exact signature for microsegmentation bypass.
Policy matrix confirms this flow is explicitly DENIED — WEB → DB-OLTP is a hard microsegmentation violation; legitimate WEB traffic should only go to APP-GW (10.3.100.10:8080) per baseline.
Baseline check shows this flow is NOT in known production patterns — web-to-appgw-proxy is the only legitimate WEB outbound; no web-to-dboltp pattern exists in steady-state baselines.
Source host web-01 is Internet-exposed (criticality=high) — if compromised, direct DB access bypasses defense-in-depth and provides attacker with direct path to crown-jewel data tier.

Destination db-oltp-01 is crown-jewel asset (criticality=critical) — direct access from untrusted WEB tier is highest-risk pattern; blast radius of compromise is transactional data exfiltration or destruction.

Past incidents show semantic similarity to SID 9000002 (WEB to APP/WORKER direct, sim=0.81) — suggests pattern of bypass attempts from this source; trust score 0.2 indicates prior enforcement history.
MITRE mapping confirms TA0008 Lateral Movement / T1021 Remote Services — this is a recognized attack technique for moving between network segments after initial foothold.
Confidence 0.95 is justified — unambiguous policy violation with no legitimate FP scenarios present; threat pattern cross_zone_violation_web_to_db has confidence anchor 0.95.

hypotheses.name: Microsegmentation bypass/lateral movement
hypotheses.description: Microsegmentation bypass/lateral movement (probability=0.95) — WEB host attempting direct DB access, bypassing the application chain. Evidence: SID 9000001 trigger, policy matrix DENY, no baseline match, MITRE TA0008/T1021. Counter: None significant; FP scenarios listed as 'extremely rare' with no supporting context.

hypotheses.name: Misconfigured monitoring tool
hypotheses.description: Misconfigured monitoring tool (probability=0.04) — A monitoring or diagnostic tool incorrectly configured to query DB from WEB tier. Evidence: None in alert context. Counter: Would be pre-announced and documented; no such context present; runtime reputation score 1.00 suggests no known legitimate tooling.

hypotheses.name: Pre-announced DB migration script
hypotheses.description: Pre-announced DB migration script (probability=0.01) — Rare scenario where migration runs from WEB host. Evidence: None. Counter: Would be in change window and documented; no such signal; past 30-day activity shows only 1 alert (SID 9000002) with no migration-related patterns.

Monitor for SID 9000009 (DB-OLTP initiating outbound) — if web-01 was already compromised, attacker may attempt C2 beacon or exfiltration from DB tier.
